_comment: Curated Resources entries that the publications manifest cannot describe:
the Whitepapers and News & Press buckets. Insights are generated from
content/publications/index.json and must NOT be listed here.
Item shape (see js/resources.js): title, href, bucket are required.
bucket is one of: whitepaper | news.  Optional: description, date, image,
Every internal href is checked against the built dist/ tree at build time by
validateResourceItems() in scripts/publications/validate.js — a dead link
fails the build. Do not add an entry whose destination does not exist yet,
and do not state a page count you have not read off the actual file.

items.title: Handbook on India's AI Regulations
items.description: A consolidated reference on India's AI regulatory landscape — statutes, advisories, sectoral guidance, and the compliance posture they demand from operating companies.
